title: This Blind Salamander Lives 100 Years and Barely Moves

scenes.text: This blind salamander can live 100 years and barely moves.
It's called the olm, and it lives in dark caves in Europe.
In an eight-year study, researchers tagged 26 olms in a cave in Bosnia.
Most stayed within about ten meters of where they started.
One appeared to sit in nearly the same spot for seven years.
Olms may live about a hundred years, and can survive long stretches without food.
A hundred years, and it hardly ever left home.

description:
A blind cave salamander may live 100 years and barely move.
In an eight-year study, one olm seemed to stay in the same spot for seven years.
Could you stay home that long?
first_comment: One spot for seven years. What's the longest you've stayed put?
